Chromium preview navigation, six-model filters, immutable import conflicts, editing invalidation, escaped user text, evaluation/report/download, mobile navigation and layout.

Real uvicorn process over loopback HTTP, authentication, import/export, SQLite backup and unchanged record hashes after actual process restart.
not_executed: No AWS account authentication or live API inventory; no IAM policy attachment or simulation against an account.

first_live_gate: Inspect one approved AWS account and one local runtime; verify identity, explicit coverage, persistence and offline restore before specifying a real incident test.
